title: aeiou parameter file
description: A named set of values for the parameter slots of one abstract (schema/README.md §8): the second artifact of the shape/parameters split. Values have the form of the AST's parameter defaults (a scalar, a distribution, or an array of these) and must have the same kind as the default they replace. `aeiou run --params FILE` applies it over the defaults and under `--param`; several files apply in order.

abstract.description: Name of the abstract this set is for.

ast_sha256.description: When present, the exact AST this set was fitted for; the runner refuses any other.

params.description: Parameter name to value. `gpus` may not appear.

provenance.description: How the set was made (tool, source, dates). Never compared.
